# NotchMuse

> NotchMuse is a free, lightweight native desktop lyrics app for macOS (Swift/AppKit) and Windows (Preview Coming Soon) that displays live synced lyrics around the MacBook notch, in the menu bar / taskbar, or as a click-through floating desktop overlay across 36+ music players. No account or login is required.

## Core Facts

- **Price & Account**: Free to download and use; no account or login required.
- **Platforms & Requirements**:
  - **macOS**: macOS 14 or later on Apple silicon Macs (M1 series or later; latest stable v0.8.5 Build 83).
  - **Windows**: Windows 11 / Windows 10 (64-bit), target installer < 30 MB (Preview Coming Soon).
- **Supported Players (36+)**: Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, NetEase Cloud Music, QQ Music, Soda Music, Kugou, Kuwo, Migu, Bodian, Qianqian, LX Music, YesPlayMusic, AlgerMusicPlayer, Listen 1, SPlayer, TIDAL, Qobuz, Amazon Music, Deezer, Cider, Plexamp, Roon, foobar2000, MusicBee, Audirvana, Swinsian, VOX, Pine Player, Cog, Feishin, Supersonic, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, browser web players, plus manual-only IINA, VLC, and Bilibili.
- **Display Modes**:
  - **Notch Mode (macOS)**: Dynamic Island–style synced lyrics around the MacBook notch or positioned above the Dock.
  - **Status Bar / Taskbar Mode**: Compact scrolling lyrics in the macOS menu bar or Windows taskbar.
  - **Floating Overlay**: Click-through, freely positionable desktop overlay with position lock, color presets, opacity, width, and animation speed controls.
  - **Immersive Lyrics View**: Full-page synced lyrics with click-to-seek, smooth line sweep, and curated theme presets.
- **Local LRC Tools**: 100% in-browser LRC to SRT converter, LRC time shifter (±ms / ±s with automatic zero-clamping), SRT to LRC converter, and plain-text extractor. Zero file uploads.
- **Privacy**: The desktop app does not read or upload audio and requires no account. Track metadata (title and artist) may be sent to lyrics providers to find a match.
- **Latest Download**: https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse/releases/latest
- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/Xiye88/NotchMuse
- **Support**: support@notchmuse.com
